en.title: Google Research releases Antigravity teamwork and Gemini 4 for scientific problem solving
en.summary: According to Google Research: Google Research reports recent results from **Antigravity's teamwork** multiagent systems combined with **Gemini 4 models**, which tackle complex problems across mathematics, computer science, and engineering. According to Google, these tools pair parallel generation with dedicated verifiers to bridge the gap in model predictability and partition context to maintain multi-day task accuracy. Google is making these agentic tools **available externally** to researchers and developers.
en.full_summary:
According to Google Research:

## Background and Design
Google Research details the design and applications of Antigravity's teamwork multiagent systems, built on top of various Gemini models including Gemini 4 Argon, Carbon, and Hydrogen. Frontier research requires navigating vast literature, building computational pipelines, and verifying every step. To address the unreliability of single model generations and the loss of context in multi-day tasks, teamwork uses parallel exploration paired with dedicated falsifiers like Lean 4 proof checkers and execution simulators, while partitioning context across specialized agents.

## Scientific and Engineering Results
According to Google, teams across Google and academic institutions used these multi-agent workflows to solve long-standing open problems. In mathematics and theoretical computer science, researchers proved the 2013 Courtade–Kumar conjecture, resolved a 2014 open question in adaptive data analysis, and formalized complex proofs in Lean 4, including the Weil conjectures and parts of the Navier–Stokes equations. In systems software and hardware engineering, the tools were used to build the FarArray low-latency kernel-bypass system, rewrite large codebases like the Zircon microkernel and libgav1 into safe Rust, and optimize TPU kernels, yielding significant performance gains over manual implementations.

## Availability
Google states that these features, along with the /boost command and Deep Review document evaluation tools, are currently available in Antigravity. Additionally, Google has opened applications providing 10,000 academic researchers with six months of free access to their highest usage tier.

zh.title: 谷歌研究院发布 Antigravity teamwork 与 Gemini 4 用于攻克科学难题
zh.summary: 据Google Research发布的信息：谷歌研究院公布了 **Antigravity teamwork** 多智能体系统结合 **Gemini 4 模型** 的最新成果，用于攻克数学、计算机科学和工程领域的复杂难题。据谷歌称，这些工具将并行生成与专用验证器相结合，解决了模型预测不准的问题，并通过隔离上下文来维持多天任务的准确性。谷歌正向研究人员和开发者**外部开放**这些智能体工具。
zh.full_summary:
据Google Research发布的信息：

## 背景与系统设计
谷歌研究院详细介绍了 Antigravity teamwork 多智能体系统的设计与应用，该系统基于 Gemini 4 Argon、Carbon 和 Hydrogen 等多种模型构建。前沿研究需要查阅大量文献、构建计算流水线并验证每个步骤。为了解决单次模型生成的不确定性以及长周期任务中的上下文丢失问题，teamwork 采用了并行探索与专用验证器（如 Lean 4 证明检查器和执行模拟器）相结合的方式，同时将上下文分配给不同的专业智能体进行隔离处理。

## 科学与工程成果
据谷歌称，谷歌及学术机构的团队利用这些多智能体工作流解决了多个长期存在的开放性难题。在数学和理论计算机科学领域，研究人员证明了 2013 年的 Courtade–Kumar 猜想，解决了自 2014 年以来在自适应数据分析中悬而未决的问题，并在 Lean 4 中形式化了复杂的数学证明，包括韦伊猜想以及纳维-斯托克斯方程的部分内容。在系统软件和硬件工程方面，这些工具被用于构建 FarArray 低延迟内核旁路系统，将 Zircon 微内核和 libgav1 等大型代码库重写为安全的 Rust 语言，并优化了 TPU 内核，相比手写实现取得了显著的性能提升。

## 获取方式
谷歌表示，这些功能以及 /boost 命令和 Deep Review 文档评估工具目前已在 Antigravity 中上线。此外，谷歌还开放了申请通道，向 10,000 名学术研究人员提供为其六个月的最高使用层级免费访问权限。

en.title: Jensen Huang Steps Down as NVIDIA CEO
en.summary: NVIDIA announces that **Jensen Huang** has stepped down from his roles as president, CEO, and board director, with immediate effect. **Colette Kress** has been appointed as interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent successor.
en.full_summary:
NVIDIA announced that Jensen Huang has resigned from his positions as president, CEO, and board member after leading the company for 33 years since its founding in 1993. Following the announcement, the company's stock experienced a significant drop in pre-market trading before recovering slightly. 

Executive Vice President and CFO Colette Kress has been named interim CEO while maintaining her current financial responsibilities. Kress has been with NVIDIA for over 13 years and previously held financial leadership roles at Cisco and Microsoft. Additionally, the board appointed Harvey C. Jones as NVIDIA's first-ever board chairman. The company confirmed that its Q3 fiscal 2027 earnings will be released on November 17 as originally scheduled.

英伟达官方宣布，自1993年联合创办公司以来掌舵33年的黄仁勋已辞去总裁、首席执行官及董事职务。受此重大人事变动影响，英伟达股价在消息公布后出现剧烈波动，盘前一度大跌超过13%，随后跌幅有所收窄。

en.title: Google Introduces Gemini 4 Hydrogen Model for Fast Execution and Agentic Workflows
en.summary: According to Google DeepMind: Google is introducing **Gemini 4 Hydrogen**, a new model designed for rapid execution and everyday agentic workflows. Available across Google AI Studio, the Gemini API, and the Gemini app, Hydrogen offers flat pricing at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens while delivering significant speed and efficiency upgrades over its predecessor.
en.full_summary:
According to Google DeepMind:

## Background and Positioning
Google is rolling out Gemini 4 Hydrogen to bring cutting-edge intelligence and speed to everyday coding and agentic workflows. While frontier models like Carbon and Argon handle deep, long-horizon reasoning on complex problems, Hydrogen is built as an efficient execution engine for rapid tasks and multi-model collaboration.

## Performance and Features
According to Google, Hydrogen surpasses Argon on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at its default high-thinking level. It features a 1-million-token context window with flat pricing of $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens. In developer benchmarks, it triples its predecessor's Terminal-Bench scores and significantly reduces hallucinated claims. The model supports four adjustable thinking levels to balance quality, latency, and cost.

## Ecosystem Integration
Hydrogen is rolling out globally across the Gemini API, Google AI Studio, the Gemini app, Google Search, and enterprise tools. Google is also introducing Orchestrator in Google Antigravity, a feature that dynamically switches between models like Carbon and Hydrogen within a single session to optimize task success rates while reducing token quota consumption.

zh.title: 谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 模型，主打快速执行与智能体工作流
zh.summary: 据Google DeepMind发布的信息：谷歌推出了全新模型 **Gemini 4 Hydrogen**，旨在提供快速执行能力和日常的智能体工作流。该模型已全面上线谷歌各大开发和消费端产品，在保持极高性价比的同时，带来了显著的**速度与效率提升**。
zh.full_summary:
据Google DeepMind发布的信息：

## 背景与定位
谷歌正式发布了 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 模型，旨在将前沿的AI智能以高速度和高效率带入日常编程与智能体工作流中。虽然谷歌的旗舰模型 Carbon 和 Argon 专注于处理复杂的长周期推理任务，但 Hydrogen 的核心定位则是作为一个高效的执行引擎，胜任各类高频和多步骤的日常任务。

## 性能与关键细节
据谷歌称，Hydrogen 在默认的高思考水平下，其人工智能指数表现超越了 Argon。该模型支持 100 万 token 的上下文窗口，输入价格为每百万 token 1.50 美元，输出价格为每百万 token 7.50 美元。在开发者测试中，它的 Terminal-Bench 得分比上一代 Flash 模型提升了三倍以上，并大幅降低了错误信息的产生。此外，它提供了四个不同的思考层级，让用户可以根据实际需求在质量、延迟和成本之间自由权衡。

## 生态整合与应用
Hydrogen 目前正在向全球的开发者、企业和普通消费者全面推送，覆盖 Gemini API、AI Studio、Gemini App 以及谷歌搜索。同时，谷歌在 Google Antigravity 中推出了 Orchestrator 功能，能够在单个会话中根据需要动态切换不同模型，从而在保证任务成功率的同时有效节省 token 消耗。

en.title: MiniMax Open-Sources H3-Image Model with Native 4K and Advanced Reasoning
en.summary: Chinese AI company MiniMax has open-sourced its flagship image generation model, **H3-Image**, featuring native 4K resolution and advanced spatial reasoning. The model aims to eliminate the typical artificial look of AI images by handling intricate details, complex text layouts, and even **CAD-style mechanical breakdowns**. Positioned as a strong competitor in multimodal AI, the model is available via open-source and low-cost API pricing.
en.full_summary:
## Background
MiniMax, known for its focus on multimodal AI development, has followed up on its video model releases by introducing H3-Image, a new SOTA-level image generation model designed to tackle both aesthetic quality and logical reasoning in visual tasks.

## Capabilities and Performance
According to tests and company reports, H3-Image significantly reduces the artificial appearance common in AI-generated images, successfully rendering human skin textures, realistic lighting, and complex reflections. Beyond aesthetics, the model demonstrates strong spatial awareness and reasoning. It can generate standard orthographic three-view drawings from reference photos, create mechanical explosion diagrams with assembly logic, and accurately typeset and solve complex academic content such as calculus exams.

## Ecosystem and Impact
Supporting up to 16 reference images for character and style consistency, H3-Image delivers native 4K resolution (16MP) with generation speeds under 20 seconds. By offering the model as open-source alongside competitively priced API access, MiniMax aims to lower the barrier for commercial applications ranging from industrial design and gaming concepts to marketing materials.

zh.title: MiniMax开源H3-Image生图模型，支持原生4K与复杂逻辑推理
zh.summary: 国内AI公司MiniMax开源了其旗舰图像生成模型**H3-Image**，支持原生4K分辨率与强大的空间理解能力。该模型通过逼真的细节处理、复杂的文本排版以及**CAD机械拆解**等功能，大幅减少了传统AI画图的塑料感。作为一款多模态领域的重磅底座，它不仅支持开源，还提供了**白菜价的API调用**服务。
zh.full_summary:
## 背景与定位
专注于多模态技术路线的AI企业MiniMax，在推出开源视频旗舰模型后，再次发布了全新的旗舰图像生成模型H3-Image。该模型旨在突破传统AI生图在美学质感与逻辑推理上的瓶颈，为全球开发者提供一个兼具美商与智商的开源底座。

## 核心能力与表现
根据实测显示，H3-Image有效改善了过去AI生图常见的塑料感与恐怖谷效应，能够精准还原人类皮肤纹理、复杂光影以及微小细节。在逻辑与空间理解方面，该模型表现出极强的泛化能力，不仅能根据外观图自动生成**标准的CAD三视图**与带有装配逻辑的机械拆解爆炸图，还能完美渲染高数试卷等高密度学术文本并给出解题步骤。

## 效率与行业影响
H3-Image支持高达16张参考图输入，保障了角色一致性与分镜连贯性，同时实现了**原生4K分辨率**的快速输出。除了开源供开发者自由定制外，其API调用价格也相对亲民。这一进展表明，垂直领域的图像模型正在通过高精度和低成本，加速向工业设计、游戏概念和跨境营销等严肃生产力场景渗透。

en.title: Release v5.23.0 - New Model Additions and Exporters Update
en.summary: Hugging Face Transformers version **5.23.0** introduces a variety of new multi-modal and language models, including Inkling2, Liquid AI's LFM3, and InternLM3. It also overhauls the **model exporters**, allowing users to seamlessly export and run models on optimized runtimes like ONNX Runtime and OpenVINO with significant speed improvements.
en.full_summary:
## New Model Additions

This release adds support for several prominent model families. **Inkling2** is a multi-modal model supporting text and image inputs with a large parameter scale. Liquid AI's **LFM3** and **LFM3-VL** introduce hybrid architectures combining gated short convolutions and grouped-query attention. Other notable additions include **IQuestCoder** for code generation, Shanghai AI Laboratory's **InternLM3** instruction-tuned model, and experimental decision heads like **JEV**.

## Exporters and Backend Runtimes

The update brings a major overhaul to model exports. Every export now returns an **ExportedModel**, which shares the same API as the original model and can be pushed to the Hub and reloaded. It supports Dynamo, ONNX Runtime, OpenVINO, and ExecuTorch, with built-in runtime fusions that make decoding significantly faster than standard PyTorch eager execution.

## Core Bugfixes and Optimizations

Beyond new models, version 5.23.0 addresses a wide range of issues across vision pipelines, distributed training, attention mechanisms, caching, and audio processing. These include fixing **cache correctness** in various models, optimizing expert parallelism, and improving overall stability for multi-GPU setups.

zh.title: 版本 v5.23.0 发布 - 引入全新模型支持与导出功能升级
zh.summary: Hugging Face Transformers **5.23.0** 版本带来了多款全新的多模态与语言模型，包括 Inkling2、Liquid AI 的 LFM3 以及 InternLM3。同时，该版本大幅升级了**模型导出器**，让用户能够将模型无缝导出并在 ONNX Runtime 和 OpenVINO 等优化运行时上运行，大幅提升了运行速度。
zh.full_summary:
## 全新模型加入

本次更新加入了多个重要模型系列的支持。**Inkling2** 是一种支持文本和图像输入的大规模参数多模态模型。Liquid AI 的 **LFM3** 与 **LFM3-VL** 引入了结合门控短卷积与分组查询注意力的混合架构。此外，新增的模型还包括用于代码生成的 **IQuestCoder**、上海人工智能实验室的 **InternLM3** 指令微调模型，以及实验性质的决策头 **JEV**。

## 导出器与后端运行时

更新对模型导出功能进行了重大重构。现在的每次导出都会返回一个 **ExportedModel**，它与原模型拥有相同的 API，并且可以推送到 Hub 并重新加载。该功能全面支持 Dynamo、ONNX Runtime、OpenVINO 和 ExecuTorch，内置的运行时融合技术让解码速度远超标准的 PyTorch 急切执行模式。

## 核心Bug修复与优化

除了新模型，5.23.0 版本还修复了视觉流水线、分布式训练、注意力机制、缓存以及音频处理等多个领域的各种问题。其中包括修复多种模型中的**缓存正确性**、优化专家并行机制，以及提升多 GPU 设置的整体稳定性。

en.title: US Lawmakers Summon Ex-Nvidia CEO After Spy Scandal
en.summary: US lawmakers have summoned **Nvidia's former CEO** to face questions in December following his resignation over extramarital affairs, including one with a **suspected Chinese spy**. The scandal has wiped nearly **half a trillion dollars** off Nvidia's market value and triggered national security concerns.
en.full_summary:
Following the resignation of Nvidia's long-time leader after reports of extramarital affairs, US lawmakers have moved quickly to demand answers. Republican Senator Tim Scott requested that the former CEO and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick testify before the Senate Banking Committee in December, while three House committees also called for a closed-door interview. 

Reports allege that one of the individuals involved was an asset of China's Ministry of State Security, raising serious concerns regarding the protection of sensitive US technology. The unfolding situation has wiped almost half a trillion dollars off Nvidia's market valuation, thrown the company into leadership transition with CFO Colette Kress serving as interim CEO, and left the broader AI industry navigating uncharted political and security waters.

zh.title: 美国议员在间谍丑闻后传唤英伟达前CEO

zh.full_summary:

en.title: LLMON: An LLM-Native Markup Language, now in Granite 4.1 3B and 8B
en.summary: Researchers have developed **LLMON**, an LLM-native markup language designed to explicitly communicate structure and semantics to models, bypassing the limitations of traditional JSON. By separating instructions from data using reserved special tokens, the newly released experimental **Granite 4.1 LLMON preview** models achieve significantly higher resistance to prompt injection attacks while maintaining general capabilities.
en.full_summary:
## Background and Motivation
Large language models rely heavily on context to generate tokens, but traditional formats like JSON were designed for parsers rather than causal models. Because transformers struggle with long spans and statistical quotation matching, models can become brittle or vulnerable to attacks such as prompt injections. To fix this, developers created **LLMON (LLM Object Notation)**, which uses an XML-like structure with reserved special tokens to cleanly separate instructions, data, and requirements.

## Implementation and Capabilities
Today, experimental preview models derived from Granite 4.1 base models, specifically **granite-4.1-3b-LLMON-preview and granite-4.1-8b-LLMON-preview**, have been released alongside a GitHub toolkit. Unlike regular chat templates that flatten inputs into a single string, LLMON wraps semantically coherent components in meaningful tags and uses an execution block to bind specific instructions to their exact data payloads. Evaluated on the OPI benchmark, these models **virtually eliminate static indirect prompt injections**, showing significantly higher robustness compared to standard open-source and closed-source models while matching general capabilities.

zh.title: LLMON：专为大模型打造的原生标记语言，现已登陆 Granite 4.1 3B 与 8B
zh.summary: 研究人员推出了 **LLMON**，这是一种专为大模型设计的原生标记语言，用来明确地向模型传递结构和语义，从而解决传统 JSON 格式在大模型应用中的痛点。通过利用预留的特殊符号将指令与数据**严格隔离**，新发布的实验性 **Granite 4.1 LLMON 预览版**模型在保持通用能力的同时，大幅提升了抗提示词注入攻击的能力。
zh.full_summary:
## 背景与动机
大语言模型非常依赖上下文来生成后续内容，但像 JSON 这样的传统格式原本是为解析器设计的，而不是为因果语言模型准备的。由于大模型很难准确追踪长文本中的嵌套结构和括号，它们常常表现得很脆弱，甚至容易遭到提示词注入等攻击。为此，开发团队推出了 **LLMON（LLM Object Notation）**，这是一种采用类似 XML 结构的标记语言，通过特殊的保留符号来明确划分指令、数据和各项要求。

## 实现细节与实际效果
基于 Granite 4.1 基础模型改进的两个实验性预览版——**granite-4.1-3b-LLMON-preview 和 granite-4.1-8b-LLMON-preview** 现已发布，并附带了相关的 GitHub 工具包。与将所有内容压缩成一个字符串的传统聊天模板不同，LLMON 会用有意义的标签包裹不同的语义组件，并通过执行块把特定的指令同对应的数据精确绑定。在 OPI 基准测试中，这些模型**基本消除了间接提示词注入**带来的安全隐患，在抗攻击能力上大幅超越了普通开源和闭源模型，同时保持了原有的通用性能。

en.title: Biopharma industry looks beyond GLP-1s for next-gen weight loss treatments
en.summary: At the ObesityWeek 2026 conference, biopharma companies are shifting attention beyond standard GLP-1 drugs to explore new pathways like **amylin modulation**. Industry experts emphasize that the next generation of weight loss therapies will focus heavily on **improving treatment persistence** and the quality of weight reduction, particularly preserving muscle mass.
en.full_summary:
## Amylin Pipeline Competition
As existing GLP-1 treatments like Wegovy and Zepbound face challenges regarding side effects and plateauing results, **amylin analogs** are emerging as a primary alternative. Companies such as Novo Nordisk, Eli Lilly, and a partnership between Roche and Zealand Pharma are showcasing data for their pipeline assets, balancing higher efficacy against tolerability trade-offs.

## Muscle Preservation and Quality
Beyond raw weight loss numbers, companies are prioritizing body composition. Biohaven and Wave Life Sciences are presenting data on therapies designed to target myostatin and INHBE proteins, aiming to **reduce fat while preserving lean muscle**, addressing a major drawback of current incretin drugs.

## Persistence and Long-Term Value
Industry leaders note that roughly half of patients drop out of treatment within six months. Presentations at the conference, including Rhythm Pharmaceuticals' long-term data, highlight the growing importance of **treatment durability** and persistence in determining the true commercial and clinical value of obesity therapeutics.

zh.title: 减肥药迎来新变局：医药巨头齐聚年会，探索超越GLP-1的新疗法
zh.summary: 在 2026 年肥胖症学术大会上，各大生物医药公司开始将目光投向标准的 GLP-1 药物之外，重点探索**胰淀素调节**等全新靶点。行业专家指出，新一代减肥疗法将更加关注**提高患者依从性**以及减脂质量，特别是如何在线上减重的同时保住肌肉。
zh.full_summary:
## 胰淀素靶点的激烈角逐
随着现有的 Wegovy 和 Zepbound 等 GLP-1 药物面临副作用和减重瓶颈，**胰淀素类似物**正成为各大药企争夺的下一个热门靶点。诺和诺德、礼来以及罗氏与 Zealand Pharma 的合作项目都在会上展示了各自管线的最新数据，在追求更高疗效的同时，也面临着耐受性等安全权衡。

## 肌肉保护与减脂质量
除了单纯的体重下降数字，生物医药行业开始高度关注身体成分的改善。Biohaven 和 Wave Life Sciences 等公司正在展示针对肌肉生长抑制素等靶点的疗法，旨在**在减少脂肪的同时保留肌肉**，以此解决现有肠促胰岛素药物的一个主要痛点。

## 治疗依从性与长期价值
行业专家指出，大约有一半的患者在接受减肥治疗六个月内会选择放弃。本次会议上 Rhythm Pharmaceuticals 等公司带来的长期数据表明，**治疗的持久性**和患者依从性，正成为评估肥胖症疗法商业潜力和临床价值的关键指标。

en.title: Google Announces 'Gemini 4 Hydrogen', a Fast and Low-Cost Model Available to Free Users
en.summary: Google has announced **Gemini 4 Hydrogen**, a new AI model focused on speed and efficiency for everyday coding and agent tasks. According to Google, it is **2.5 times faster** than the previous generation model and is already rolling out globally, including for free users.
en.full_summary:
## Background and Positioning
Google has introduced Gemini 4 Hydrogen as the third model in the Gemini 4 series, following Argon and Carbon. Google positions Hydrogen as its **mainstream model for daily agent tasks**, emphasizing speed and efficiency.

## Performance and Comparisons
According to Artificial Analysis, Hydrogen scores 51 points on standard reasoning, outperforming Argon. Google reports it is about 2.5 times faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash. In Google's benchmark comparisons against Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 5.5 and OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Terra, Hydrogen led in 7 out of 10 items, including the HLE-Diamond reasoning test at 58.8%, while trailing in terminal operations and computer use.

## Pricing and Availability
Hydrogen features a 1-million-token context window. API pricing is set at **$1.50 per million input tokens** and $7.50 per output token. It is available immediately across multiple developer platforms, Google Workspace tools, and the free tier of the Gemini app.

zh.title: Google发布高速低价的“Gemini 4 Hydrogen”，免费用户也可使用
zh.summary: Google正式发布了主打速度与效率的AI模型**Gemini 4 Hydrogen**，适合日常编程和AI代理任务。据Google称，它的运行速度比上一代轻量模型**快大约2.5倍**，并且从发布当天起就开始面向全球用户（包括免费用户）逐步推出。
zh.full_summary:
## 背景与定位
Google推出了Gemini 4系列的第三个模型Gemini 4 Hydrogen，前两个为Argon和Carbon。Google将Hydrogen定位为日常代理任务的**主力模型**，主打速度与效率。

## 性能表现与对比
根据Artificial Analysis的数据，Hydrogen标准思考水平得分为51分。Google称其速度比上一代Gemini 3.8 Flash快约2.5倍。在Google与Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5.5及OpenAI GPT-6.1 Terra的对比中，Hydrogen在10个测试项目中的7个领先，其中包括58.8%的HLE-Diamond推理能力测试，但在终端操作等3个项目上落后于对手。

## 价格与可用性
该模型拥有100万个token的上下文窗口。API定价为每百万输入token **1.5美元**、输出token 7.5美元。目前它已通过多个开发者平台、Workspace工具以及Gemini免费版向全球用户提供。

en.title: Delix raises $100M for depression drug without psychedelic trips
en.summary: Delix Therapeutics has secured **$100 million in Series C** funding to advance zalsupindole, a **non-hallucinatory psychedelic** therapy designed to treat major depressive disorder. Backed by Johnson & Johnson, the company plans to start a **Phase 2b clinical trial** in 2027.
en.full_summary:
## Background
Delix Therapeutics, a Boston-based biotech born from a University of California lab in 2019, focuses on developing neuroplastogens, a class of drugs aimed at regrowing lost brain connections without causing traditional psychedelic trips. 

## Details
The newly raised $100 million Series C round was led by J&J's venture arm, with participation from several other investors. The funds will primarily advance its lead oral candidate, zalsupindole, which is based on a naturally occurring compound found in plants and toad secretions. Delix reported positive **Phase 1b safety data** in healthy volunteers in late 2024 and aims to launch a **Phase 2b trial** for major depressive disorder in the first half of 2027.

## Impact
Beyond depression, the capital will support the pipeline's expansion into other neurological and neurodegenerative conditions, such as schizophrenia and Alzheimer's disease. The deal arrives amid renewed industry momentum, highlighted by recent high-profile acquisitions and regulatory focus on psychedelic-based mental health treatments.

zh.title: Delix 融资 1.05 亿美元研发不产生幻觉的抑郁症药物
zh.summary: Delix Therapeutics 获得了 **1 亿美元 C 轮融资**，用于推进其用于治疗抑郁症的**无幻觉致幻剂**疗法 zalsupindole。该公司由强生等机构支持，计划在 2027 年启动 **2b 期临床试验**。
zh.full_summary:
## 背景
Delix Therapeutics 是一家总部位于波士顿的生物技术公司，于 2019 年从加州大学实验室孵化而出，专注于开发能够恢复大脑神经连接的“神经塑形剂”，目标是避开传统致幻剂的致幻副作用。

## 细节
该公司新完成的 1 亿美元 C 轮融资由强生旗下风险投资机构领投，多 家投资方跟进。这笔资金将主要用于推进其核心口服候选药物 zalsupindole，该药物源自植物和蟾蜍分泌物中的天然化合物。Delix 在 2024 年底公布了健康志愿者的 **1b 期积极安全数据**，并计划在 2027 年上半年针对重度抑郁症启动 **2b 期临床试验**。

## 影响
除了抑郁症，这笔资金还将用于支持该技术在精神分裂症和阿尔茨海默病等其他神经系统疾病上的管线拓展。此次融资正值整个行业对精神类药物研发重燃兴趣之际，近期多起巨额收购和政策倾斜正推动该领域加速发展。

en.title: Experts fear Treasury's proposed China biotech investment ban will backfire on U.S. leadership
en.summary: The U.S. Treasury's proposed rules to restrict outbound investments in China's biopharma sector have sparked intense concern among industry leaders and legal experts. While Washington aims to protect national and economic security, critics like RA Capital's Peter Kolchinsky warn that the vague regulations—particularly around joint ventures—will **blind U.S. investors**, cripple domestic innovation, and inadvertently hand a competitive advantage to European and Chinese rivals.
en.full_summary:
## The Proposed Rules and Industry Anxiety
The U.S. Department of the Treasury released a 163-page draft policy detailing how it plans to implement the COINS Act, which seeks to add pharmaceutical compounds to an outbound investment blacklist. While traditional cash-based licensing deals remain untouched, the proposal places ambiguous restrictions on equity investments, co-development deals, and joint ventures involving Chinese entities, leaving biopharma executives and trade attorneys struggling to define compliant behavior.

## The Threat of a 'Flying Blind' Strategy
Industry heavyweights, including a coalition of prominent healthcare investors led by RA Capital, argue that the rules will backfire. By barring U.S. investors and drugmakers from engaging in equity and co-commercialization structures in China, American firms will lose vital visibility into the global clinical pipeline. Critics warn that European investors and multinational pharmaceutical companies—unbound by these strict rules—will **scoop up promising Chinese assets**, leaving U.S. players at a severe disadvantage.

## The 'Joint Venture' Riddle and Economic Security
A major source of confusion is the Treasury's lack of a clear legal definition for 'joint ventures,' which threatens popular models like U.S.-based 'NewCos' formed around Chinese-licensed assets. Legal experts note that the broad scope reflects a shifting political reality where **economic security is treated as national security**. Although the industry is pushing for narrower definitions focused strictly on bioweapons or select agents, analysts suggest that policymakers are determined to protect U.S. technological leadership across the board, regardless of the compliance burden and potential chilling effect on cross-border R&D.

zh.title: 专家警告：美国财政部限制对华生物技术投资的提案或将适得其反
zh.summary: 美国财政部关于限制对华生物医药领域对外投资的拟议规则，引发了业内领袖和法律专家的广泛担忧。尽管华盛顿的初衷是维护国家和经济安全，但以RA Capital的彼得·科尔钦斯基为首的批评者警告称，这些含糊不清的规定（尤其是关于合资企业的条款）将**蒙蔽美国投资者**的双眼，削弱本土创新能力，并无意中将竞争优势拱手让给欧洲和中国对手。
zh.full_summary:
## 拟议规则与行业焦虑
美国财政部发布了一份长达163页的政策草案，详细阐述了如何实施《全面对外投资国家安全法》（COINS法案），该法案旨在将“药物化合物”列入对外投资黑名单。虽然传统的现金许可交易暂不受影响，但该提案对涉及中国实体的股权投资、共同开发协议以及合资企业施加了含糊不清的限制，这让生物医药高管和贸易律师在界定合规行为时陷入困境。

## “盲目飞行”的战略威胁
包括由RA Capital领导的一批知名医疗健康投资者在内的行业重量级人物争辩称，这些规则将适得其反。通过禁止美国投资者和药企在中国参与股权和共同商业化结构，美国公司将失去对全球临床管线的关键洞察力。批评人士警告称，不受这些严格规则约束的欧洲投资者和跨国制药公司将**抢购中国优质资产**，从而令美国企业处于严重劣势。
## “合资企业”谜题与经济安全
引发困惑的一个主要原因是财政部对“合资企业”缺乏清晰的法律定义，这威胁到了围绕中国授权资产建立的美国本土“新公司（NewCo）”等热门模式。法律专家指出，其广泛的适用范围反映了一个正在转变的政治现实，即**经济安全已被视为国家安全**。尽管业界正敦促将范围缩小至生物武器或特定病原体，但分析人士认为，决策者决心全面保护美国的领先技术地位，而较少顾及合规负担以及对跨境研发可能造成的冷却效应。

en.title: Bill Gates-backed Breakthrough Energy says global decarbonization would cost 7.5 trillion dollars
en.summary: According to MIT Climate: At an MIT energy conference, Breakthrough Energy CTO Eric Toone reported that **global decarbonization** would cost roughly 7.5 trillion dollars, or 5 percent of world GDP. Utilizing **artificial intelligence** to analyze costs, the firm emphasizes that success relies heavily on eliminating the green premium because people are generally unwilling to pay extra for eco-friendly alternatives.
en.full_summary:
According to MIT Climate:

## Background and Costs
Eric Toone, chief technical officer at Breakthrough Energy, spoke at MIT's annual energy conference, highlighting that rising global prosperity inherently drives up energy demand and greenhouse gas emissions. According to Toone, while decarbonizing the world economy is entirely feasible, the true challenge lies not just in the calculated **7.5 trillion dollar cost**, but in the reality that consumers and even wealthy individuals are largely unwilling to pay extra for zero-carbon alternatives. By enlisting artificial intelligence, the organization estimated this multi-trillion-dollar price tag, which could potentially drop to 3.5 trillion dollars if emerging technologies succeed.

## Technology Solutions
Breakthrough Energy Ventures has deployed approximately 3 billion dollars into roughly 140 companies tackling clean energy challenges. Noteworthy examples include Luxwall, which produces **highly insulating windows** capable of cutting commercial building energy use by 30 percent, and Form Energy, which is developing iron-air batteries designed to store power for up to a month. Other portfolio companies are addressing cement emissions, upgrading transmission lines, advancing geothermal drilling through adapted fracking technology, and creating magnetic containment solutions for fusion energy.

## Industry Impact
Toone noted that while Breakthrough's investments are substantial, they represent only a fraction of broader global clean tech funding. The ultimate hurdle facing the energy transition is the sheer scale of existing infrastructure that must be replaced, making it critical to deploy these innovative technologies directly into emerging and developing economies to prevent future carbon-heavy infrastructure buildouts.

zh.title: 比尔·盖茨支持的突破能源称全球去碳化成本约为7.5万亿美元
zh.summary: 据MIT Climate发布的信息：在麻省理工学院的一场能源会议上，突破能源首席技术官埃里克·图恩表示，实现**全球去碳化**大约需要7.5万亿美元，约占全球GDP的5%。该机构利用**人工智能**分析了去碳成本，并强调成功的关键在于消除绿色溢价，因为消费者普遍不愿为环保产品支付额外费用。
zh.full_summary:
据MIT Climate发布的信息：

## 背景与成本
突破能源首席技术官埃里克·图恩在麻省理工学院的年度能源会议上发言指出，全球繁荣程度的提升必然会推动能源需求和温室气体排放增加。图恩表示，虽然实现全球经济去碳化完全可行，但真正的挑战不仅在于经计算得出的**7.5万亿美元成本**，更在于现实情况是消费者乃至富裕阶层大都不愿为零碳替代品支付额外费用。通过借助人工智能进行分析，该机构估算出了这一庞大的总成本，并指出如果各项新技术取得成功，这一数字有望降至3.5万亿美元。

## 技术解决方案
突破能源风险投资公司已向约140家致力于清洁能源挑战的公司投入了大约30亿美元。其中的代表企业包括卢克斯沃（Luxwall）公司，其研发的**高隔热窗户**可将商业建筑的能耗降低30%；还有正在开发能够储存长达一个月电力的铁空气电池的Form Energy。其他投资组合还涉及水泥减排、输电线路升级、利用改进的水力压裂技术推进地热钻探，以及为聚变能开发磁场约束方案。

## 行业影响
图恩指出，尽管突破能源的投资规模不小，但它只是全球更广泛清洁技术资金的一小部分。当前能源转型面临的最大障碍是必须替换庞大的现有基础设施，因此至关重要的是将这些创新技术直接部署到新兴和发展中经济体中，从而避免未来再次建设重碳基础设施。

en.title: US AI Data Centers Face Resistance from Local Politics and Community Opposition
en.summary: According to Silicon Valley 101's podcast featuring industry experts and investors, US AI data center expansion is increasingly constrained by **community opposition** and local political changes. While Wall Street worries about capital expenditure returns and potential hardware supply bottlenecks, local residents raise concerns over utility bills and environmental impacts, introducing **new delay risks** to infrastructure projects.
en.full_summary:
## Policy and Community Pressures on Infrastructure
As US AI infrastructure investments scale up, data center projects are encountering unexpected hurdles from local zoning boards, state politics, and community opposition. Industry experts note that local residents in regions like Texas and California are increasingly pushing back against massive power and water consumption, raising concerns about utility costs and long-term community benefits. These local friction points, ranging from environmental permits to grid interconnection bottlenecks, threaten to increase project costs by 10% to 20% and cause widespread construction delays.

## Market Dynamics and Supply Chain Vulnerabilities
Wall Street's recent sell-off in AI-related stocks reflects growing anxiety over the sustainability of massive capital expenditures and circular financing structures. Panelists discussed the potential mismatch between hardware supply and actual software demand, raising questions about whether data center slowdowns could create shortages in specific components while leaving upstream chip capacity vulnerable if token economics or model efficiency shift.

zh.title: 美股AI板块震荡：地方政治与社区反对成数据中心新瓶颈
zh.summary: 据《硅谷101》播客连线多位行业专家与投资人指出，美国AI数据中心的扩张正面临来自**社区反对**和地方政治变局的现实阻力。华尔街在担忧资本回报与算力供给瓶颈的同时，地方居民对电费和环境成本的忧虑已演变为**项目延期风险**的重要变量。
zh.full_summary:
## 政策与社区阻力成基础设施新瓶颈
随着美国AI基础设施投资规模持续扩大，数据中心项目正面临来自地方分区委员会、州级政治变局以及社区反对的现实阻力。业内专家指出，德州和加州等地的居民对巨额电力和水资源消耗的忧虑不断加剧，社区听证会上的反对声音正转化为对电费、供水和建设许可的实质性挑战。这些地方层面的摩擦与并网难题，不仅可能推高10%至20%的合规与建设成本，也加剧了项目延期的风险。

## 资本市场担忧与产业链传导
华尔街近期对AI板块的震荡反应，反映出市场对巨额资本开支持续性以及循环融资结构的审视。访谈嘉宾探讨了算力供给与模型需求之间的潜在错位，指出数据中心建设放缓可能会重塑产业链各环节的预期。如果基建项目因地方阻力而放缓，上游硬件与芯片的供需平衡将面临新的不确定性。

en.title: AMD Announces Instinct MI430X GPU with Native FP64 and HBM4 Memory
en.summary: According to AMD Blogs: AMD announced the Instinct MI430X GPU, built on the CDNA 5 architecture, combining **native FP64** compute with 432 GB of HBM4 memory. According to AMD, the design targets the convergence of scientific computing and AI workloads, and the hardware has already been selected for upcoming exascale systems in the US and Europe.
en.full_summary:
According to AMD Blogs:

## Hardware Architecture and Specifications
AMD reports that the Instinct MI430X GPU is designed for the convergence of high-precision scientific computing and AI workloads. Built on the **CDNA 5 architecture**, it delivers up to 288 TFLOPS of peak native FP64 performance alongside 432 GB of HBM4 memory running at 23.3 TB/s bandwidth. For multi-GPU scaling, a node pairs a 6th Gen EPYC server CPU with four GPUs using a fully connected, switchless Infinity Fabric mesh.

## Research on FP64 Emulation Limits
In a paper presented at SC26, AMD researchers evaluated the limits of Ozaki GEMM emulation on HPC systems. Their analysis suggests that **less than 10%** of the broader HPC ecosystem features workloads dense and GEMM-shaped enough to benefit from emulation, indicating that native double precision remains essential for stencils, sparse linear algebra, and molecular dynamics.

## System Deployments and Projections
AMD states that the MI430X has been selected for several prominent European and US scientific systems, including Discovery at Oak Ridge National Laboratory, Alice Recoque in France, and Herder in Germany. Performance figures provided by AMD are **projected estimates** based on engineering benchmarks comparing the MI430X to the previous-generation MI300A APU.

zh.title: AMD 发布搭载原生双精度与 HBM4 内存的 Instinct MI430X GPU
zh.summary: 据AMD Blogs发布的信息：AMD 发布了基于 CDNA 5 架构的 Instinct MI430X GPU，同时提供强大的**原生双精度**计算能力与 432 GB 的 HBM4 内存。AMD 表示，该芯片旨在融合科学计算与人工智能负载，目前已被美国和欧洲的多项超级计算机项目选为核心硬件。
zh.full_summary:
据AMD Blogs发布的信息：

## 硬件架构与核心参数
据 AMD 称，其新推出的 Instinct MI430X GPU 专为科学计算与人工智能的融合而设计。该芯片基于 **CDNA 5 架构**，拥有最高 288 TFLOPS 的原生 FP64（双精度）计算性能，并配备了高达 432 GB 的 HBM4 内存，带宽达到 23.3 TB/s。在多卡互联方面，单节点通过无交换机的 Infinity Fabric 网状架构将四块 GPU 与第六代 EPYC 服务器处理器紧密相连。

## 关于双精度模拟局限性的研究
在 SC26 会议上发表的一篇论文中，AMD 研究人员评估了通过低精度核心模拟 FP64 的局限性。他们的分析表明，在广泛的 HPC 生态系统中，**不足 10%** 的工作负载具备足够的密度来从这种模拟中获益，这证明了对于各类网格和稀疏线性代数等任务而言，原生双精度依然不可或缺。

## 系统部署与性能展望
AMD 表示，MI430X 已经获得美国橡树岭国家实验室的 Discovery、法国的 Alice Recoque 以及德国的 Herder 等多个旗舰级科学计算系统采用。不过需要注意的是，官方公布的性能提升数据目前均为**工程预测值**，系基于与上一代 MI300A 芯片的对比得出。

en.title: MIT researchers develop a new training method for faster and more trustworthy climate AI models
en.summary: According to MIT Climate: MIT researchers have created a new training technique that dramatically speeds up the production of **climate emulators**, which are AI models used to simulate future climate scenarios. By using optimized **synthetic data** instead of traditional realistic emission trajectories, the method cuts down data requirements and helps the AI adapt to **unfamiliar scenarios** that traditional models usually fail to handle.
en.full_summary:
According to MIT Climate:

Traditional earth system models used for climate projection are extremely powerful, but they take months to run on supercomputers for just a single scenario. To solve this, scientists use climate emulators, which are fast AI models that mimic full-scale systems. However, training these emulators usually requires running complex models on six to eight realistic future emission scenarios, making the data creation process slow and costly.

According to MIT researchers, emulators trained exclusively on realistic scenarios often fail to adapt when faced with unfamiliar or novel situations. To address this, the team developed an algorithm that generates a synthetic dataset of optimized, non-traditional climate scenarios tailored to boost predictive performance. By introducing rapid variations and high-frequency oscillations into the training data, the algorithm allows the emulator to extract much more information about the overall system while requiring far fewer full-scale model runs.

The resulting emulators proved capable of accurately predicting outcomes in scenarios they had never seen during training, such as local pollutant control policies where some emissions rise while others fall. Published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, this technique aims to reduce the months or years typically spent on emulator production, helping researchers and decision-makers get updated climate tools much faster.

zh.title: 麻省理工学院研究人员开发出新训练方法，让气候AI模型更快更可靠
zh.summary: 据MIT Climate发布的信息：麻省理工学院的研究人员开发了一种全新的训练技术，能大幅加速**气候模拟器**（一种用于预测未来气候的AI模型）的制作过程。通过使用优化后的**合成数据**来代替传统的真实排放轨迹，该方法不仅大幅减少了所需数据量，还能帮助AI适应传统模型通常无法应对的**陌生场景**。
zh.full_summary:
据MIT Climate发布的信息：

用于气候预测的传统地球系统模型虽然功能强大，但在超级计算机上运行单个场景往往就需要几个月的时间。为了解决这个问题，科学家们开始使用气候模拟器，也就是能够模仿完整系统的快速AI模型。不过，训练这些模拟器通常需要基于六到八种现实的未来排放场景来运行复杂模型，这使得数据创建过程既缓慢又昂贵。

据麻省理工学院的研究人员称，仅在现实场景上训练出来的模拟器，在面对陌生或新奇的情况时往往无法很好地适应。为了应对这一挑战，该团队开发了一种算法，能够生成一组优化后的、非传统的合成气候场景数据集，从而提升模型的预测性能。通过在训练数据中引入快速变化和高频波动，该算法让模拟器能够从整体系统中提取更多的信息，同时大大减少了对完整大规模模型运行的依赖。

研究表明，利用这种技术训练出来的模拟器，能够准确预测其在训练期间未曾见过的场景结果，例如某些排放上升而其他排放下降的局部污染物控制政策。这项研究已发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》上，旨在减少通常用于制作模拟器的数月甚至数年时间，帮助研究人员和决策者更快地获得更新的气候工具。

en.title: ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI's Dots agents buy things for you
en.summary: OpenAI is launching **ChatGPT Wallet** for its US Pro subscribers, allowing its Dots AI agents to make online purchases. The system uses **biometric verification** for every transaction and generates payment tokens so your actual credit card details are never shared. In the future, OpenAI plans to let users **fully delegate purchases** by setting strict limits and pre-approval rules.
en.full_summary:
## Background and Rollout
OpenAI is expanding its Dots AI agents platform, introduced earlier this year, by adding a dedicated payment tool called **ChatGPT Wallet**. The feature is rolling out to ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the US who are 18 and older, requiring a US billing address and eligible major credit cards from American Express, Chase, Mastercard, and Visa.

## Security and Privacy
OpenAI reports that users must add a card to the wallet, after which Dots agents can initiate purchases based on user prompts. However, the agent must **check in with the user** before finalizing any transaction. Every purchase requires a security check using biometric verification, such as Face ID or a fingerprint scan. Similar to Apple Pay or Google Wallet, the system replaces actual credit card details with a **payment token**, meaning card numbers are hidden from both the AI agent and the merchant.

## Future Plans and Limitations
Looking ahead, OpenAI expects users to eventually **fully delegate purchases** to their agents by defining parameters like spending limits, approved categories, or specific timeframes. However, practical hurdles remain. Some retailers restrict or block AI agents entirely, similar to how Amazon blocked Meta's Muse agents earlier this year. OpenAI notes that online stores must update their websites, payment gateways, and risk systems to **accommodate legitimate agent purchases** and prevent accidental blocking.

zh.title: ChatGPT 钱包让 OpenAI 的 Dots 智能体帮你买东西
zh.summary: OpenAI 正在面向美国 Pro 订阅用户推出 **ChatGPT 钱包**，允许其 Dots 智能体代为进行网上购物。该系统对每笔交易都进行 **生物特征验证**，并通过生成支付令牌来确保不泄露真实的信用卡信息。未来，OpenAI 计划允许用户通过设定严格的额度和预批规则来 **完全委托智能体** 进行购买。
zh.full_summary:
## 背景与推出
OpenAI 正在为其今年早些时候推出的 Dots 智能体平台添加一项名为 **ChatGPT 钱包** 的专属支付工具。该功能开始向美国 18 岁及以上的 ChatGPT Pro 订阅用户推送，需要美国账单地址以及符合条件的美国运通、大通、万事达和维萨主流信用卡。

## 安全与隐私
OpenAI 表示，用户将卡片添加至钱包后，Dots 智能体便能根据用户的指令发起购买，但在结账前必须先 **同用户确认**。每一笔交易都需要通过面容 ID 或指纹扫描等生物特征验证进行安全检查。类似于苹果或谷歌钱包，该系统会将实际的信用卡信息替换为 **支付令牌**，这意味着智能体和商家都无法看到用户的真实卡号。

## 未来规划与限制
展望未来，OpenAI 预计用户最终能够通过设定消费额度、购买类别或时间段等参数，**完全把购买任务交托** 给智能体。不过，实际落地仍面临阻力。部分零售商对 AI 智能体施加了限制甚至全面封禁，正如亚马逊今年早些时候屏蔽了 Meta 的 Muse 智能体一样。OpenAI 指出，电商网站必须更新其网站、支付和风控系统，以 **识别合法的智能体购买** 并避免被误拦截。

en.title: LangChain Raises $300M Series C at $3B Valuation
en.summary: According to LangChain Blog: LangChain announced a **$300M Series C funding** round led by CapitalG, valuing the company at **$3B**. The company aims to help enterprises own their intelligence through AI agents and its **LangSmith platform**, which is already used by over 7,000 organizations.
en.full_summary:
According to LangChain Blog:

LangChain announced that it has raised **$300 million in Series C funding** at a valuation of **$3 billion**, led by CapitalG with participation from GIC, DFJ Growth, IVP, and Sapphire Ventures. The company believes that **AI agents will transform the economy**, and every enterprise will need to control its own intelligence, data, and infrastructure to build competitive advantages.

To capture this market, LangChain highlights its **LangSmith platform**, which serves over 7,000 organizations—including Fortune 500 enterprises like NVIDIA and Toyota as well as startups like Harvey. LangSmith is structured around three core pillars: Agent Runtime (infrastructure and architecture for running agents), Agent Improvement (testing, monitoring, and automated optimization), and Agent Governance (centralized control over models, tools, and sensitive data). The company also announced an upcoming release event scheduled for Friday, November 20th, to introduce new platform capabilities.

zh.title: LangChain 获得 3 亿美元 C 轮融资，估值达 30 亿美元
zh.summary: 据LangChain Blog发布的信息：AI 开发框架公司 LangChain 宣布获得由 CapitalG 领投的 **3 亿美元 C 轮融资**，公司估值达到 **30 亿美元**。他们主打的 **LangSmith 平台**目前已被超过 7000 家机构采用，旨在帮助企业打造和掌控自己的 AI 智能体。
zh.full_summary:
据LangChain Blog发布的信息：

LangChain 宣布获得由 CapitalG 领投的 **3 亿美元 C 轮融资**，新老股东包括 GIC、DFJ Growth、IVP 以及 Sapphire Ventures 等，公司估值达到 **30 亿美元**。LangChain 认为 **AI 智能体将重塑经济**，未来每个企业都需要自主掌控其核心智能与数据，从而在竞争中建立优势。
